use_case: AI eligibility assistant (SYS-09): extracts data from verification documents and suggests SNAP, TANF, and Medicaid eligibility outcomes to agency caseworkers
business_owner: Director of Data and AI (company, developer); AG-03 program director (deployer); AG-44 deputy director (deployer from 2027-04-05)
vendor_or_model: Company-built feature on the cloud provider's managed large language model service, with retrieval of each agency's policy manual
data_categories: Applicant and household data; income and expense documents; Social Security numbers (Restricted); no FTI permitted
human_in_the_loop: Agency caseworkers (government merit staff) make every decision. From 2026-11-30: review-first design (caseworker records own finding before seeing the suggestion), caseworker reason codes only in notices, supervisor review of 10% of AI-assisted denials each week
applicable_laws: 7 CFR 272.4(a)(2) and 42 CFR 431.10(b)(3), (c)(2) (government merit staff decide); 7 CFR 273.10(g)(1)(ii), 273.15(a), 42 CFR 431.200(a) (notices and fair hearings); 7 CFR 273.2(g)(1), (i)(3)(i) (deadlines); 7 CFR 272.6(a) (nondiscrimination); 7 CFR 272.4(b) (bilingual service); N92-R04 (42 CFR 431.306(b)) and 7 CFR 272.1(c) (confidentiality); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 sec. 2.C.11.2, no FTI); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); Colorado SB26-189 (developer duties for AG-44 from 2027-01-01)
status: In production (AG-03, 3 of 6 regions, since 2025-11); approved with conditions; expansion and AG-44 go-live gated

use_case: AI coding assistant for engineers (code completion and chat in the development environment)
vendor_or_model: Commercial AI coding assistant (enterprise license, vendor-hosted model)
data_categories: Source code and configuration (Confidential); risk that secrets or agency data are pasted in
human_in_the_loop: Engineers review all suggestions; normal code review with two approvals and pipeline scanning
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.9 and POL-04 4.8 (approved tools and data rules); N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7) and N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9) if FTI or CJI were entered (prohibited)
status: In production since 2026-03 (about 150 engineers); approved with conditions after a retroactive review

use_case: Support ticket summarization and routing in the ticketing SaaS (summaries, suggested category and priority for support staff)
vendor_or_model: AI feature of the ticketing vendor (vendor-hosted model)
data_categories: Ticket text from agency users; may include agency personal data (Restricted); regulated attachments are blocked
human_in_the_loop: Support staff read the ticket and set the final priority; severity 1 and security tickets are always reviewed by a person
applicable_laws: POL-04 4.8; vendor terms (no training on customer data); Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: In production since 2026-05; approved with conditions

use_case: Public records redaction assistant sold to municipal customers (suggests redactions of personal identifiers in documents released under state public records laws)
business_owner: Director of Data and AI (company); records custodians at 6 municipal customers (deployers)
vendor_or_model: Company-built feature on the cloud provider's managed model service plus pattern matching
data_categories: Constituent records and attachments with names, addresses, phone numbers, driver license numbers (Restricted)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (release of public records); harm is disclosure of exempt personal information
human_in_the_loop: The records custodian reviews and approves every redaction before release; the assistant never releases documents
applicable_laws: Each state's public records law and its exemptions (determined by the agency); POL-04 4.8; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2); N92-R05 (18 U.S.C. 2721) where motor vehicle record information appears
status: In production for 6 municipal customers since 2026-02; approved with conditions

use_case: General-purpose public generative AI tools (consumer chatbots) for drafting, summarizing, or coding
data_categories: Risk that agency data, source code, or credentials are entered
applicable_laws: POL-05 4.9 and POL-04 4.8; N92-R01 (Pub. 1075 Exhibit 7) and N92-R02 (CJISSECPOL v6.1 SA-9) if FTI or CJI were entered; Fla. Stat. 501.171(2)
status: Not approved; blocked on company devices by web filtering; AI-002 is the approved alternative for code, and an enterprise assistant with contract terms will be evaluated in 2027 Q1
